name: monito-monita-video
description: Monito Monita portfolio demo video, built in Remotion. A separate project: nothing here is part of the app's bundle.

scripts.render: remotion render MonitoDemo out/monito-monita-demo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --audio-bitrate 320k && node scripts/render/post.mjs loudness
scripts.render:loop: remotion render MonitoLoop out/loop-full.webm --codec vp9 --crf 20 --muted && node scripts/render/post.mjs loop
